title: Dream Banquet

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered Rococo gown with a fitted corset bodice over a voluminous bell skirt, featuring a front split that reveals a contrasting petticoat. The dress showcases a prominent bustle at the back, with a high ruffled collar and puffed sleeves ending in lace cuffs, creating a structured, historically inspired, feminine couture shape.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A delicate ivory lace bonnet adorned with clusters of white fabric flowers and trailing ribbons, sitting atop soft wavy hair, finished with a sheer, airy veil or netting that adds ethereal elegance.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: An ivory silk bodice with intricate floral embroidery and a deep V-neckline framed by a ruffled lace bertha collar. The center front features a brown velvet ribbon bow and gold-tone decorative buttons. The sleeves are puffed at the shoulder with tiers of sheer organza and lace, finished with ruffled cuffs and delicate pearl accents.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A voluminous, tiered bell skirt in ivory silk, adorned with scattered floral motifs and extensive ruffled lace trim along the hem. The front split reveals a contrasting brown underlayer with ornate gold scrollwork embroidery. The skirt is gathered into a prominent bustle at the back. Footwear is not visible, but the delicate lace and ribbon detailing suggest elegant, heeled footwear.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A delicate gold necklace with a pendant and a pair of small, dangling earrings are visible. The design motifs include trailing floral vines, ribbons, and intricate scrollwork, evoking the ambiance of a candlelit banquet.
